dataset_name: KrishiSahyog official agricultural scheme research seed
purpose: Research and editorial review only; not an approved production government feed

records.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
records.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
records.summary: ₹6,000/year in three equal instalments for eligible landholding farmer families; exclusions apply
records.eligibility_summary: Landholding farmer family; qualifying exclusions and verification apply
records.farmer_action: Registration, KYS, eKYC, guidelines, FAQ and grievance links
records.review_notes: Scheme information confirmed on official portal; individual payment statuses not collected

records.name: PM-KUSUM
records.authority: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
records.summary: Components A (decentralized generation), B (standalone solar pumps), C (grid pump/feeder solarization); support varies by component/state
records.eligibility_summary: Farmer/group, pump and grid conditions differ between components
records.farmer_action: State agency, component selection and application window must be confirmed
records.review_notes: Published scheme period/application availability requires state-level verification

records.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
records.authority: Ministry of Jal Shakti / participating departments
records.summary: Har Khet Ko Pani irrigation access; PMKSY umbrella has several distinct components
records.eligibility_summary: Often project or component dependent; not a single universal direct subsidy
records.farmer_action: Read implementing component guidelines and relevant state department
records.review_notes: Separate PDMC guidelines and effective state subsidy rules

records.name: Per Drop More Crop micro-irrigation
records.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
records.summary: 2021 guidelines state 55% assistance for small/marginal and 45% for other farmers subject to norms and cost ceilings
records.eligibility_summary: Farmer category, eligible equipment and state conditions
records.farmer_action: Get effective state guideline and verified application window
records.review_notes: HISTORICAL_RULE: do not display historical percentages as currently offered without verification

records.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
records.authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
records.summary: Crop-insurance information, farmer enrolment, premium calculator, policy status, loss reporting, grievance helpline 14447
records.eligibility_summary: Crop, location, season, insurer and notification specific
records.farmer_action: Use official portal for transactions, statuses and reporting
records.review_notes: Do not scrape private policy/claim information or infer coverage

records.name: Electronic National Agriculture Market
records.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
records.summary: Registered farmer trading, lot tracking, auctions, public mandi prices and arrivals
records.eligibility_summary: Registration and APMC workflow apply; not all mandis/crops have observations
records.farmer_action: Public Agmarknet dashboard and farmer module
records.review_notes: Prices require observation date, commodity variety, unit; no price observations included in this research seed

records.name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan
records.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / Consumer Affairs
records.summary: PSS, PDPS, MIS and PSF are described in 2025 government release
records.farmer_action: Check current procurement notice, agency and MSP independently
records.review_notes: Do not infer that procurement is currently open

records.name: Kisan Credit Card and Modified Interest Subvention Scheme
records.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / banks
records.summary: 2025-26 release documents 7% short-term crop loan interest up to ₹3 lakh and incentive up to 3% for prompt repayment; 2026 publication describes later changes
records.eligibility_summary: Bank and fiscal-year specific; farmer eligibility and loan terms must be confirmed
records.farmer_action: Official bank/application guidance; no private account collection
records.review_notes: HISTORICAL_RULE: 2025 and 2026 figures must not be conflated

records.name: Soil Health Card
records.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
records.summary: Soil report of 12 parameters with fertilizer and amendment recommendations
records.eligibility_summary: Actual results require a valid soil sample and laboratory testing
records.farmer_action: Guide users to official testing and recommendation services
records.review_notes: No individual farmer soil report collected

records.name: Agricultural Mechanization / SMAM portal
records.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
records.summary: Agricultural machinery assistance, official farmer/entrepreneur registration and published state application notices
records.eligibility_summary: State allocations and active windows differ
records.review_notes: State windows should be stored separately with start/end and source

records.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
records.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
records.summary: Official SOP discusses 3% interest subvention for eligible loans up to ₹2 crore
records.eligibility_summary: Entity/project/lender eligibility subject to official rules
records.farmer_action: Financing application guidance and lender handoff
records.review_notes: Historical SOP, verify current active terms before eligibility

records.name: Watershed Development Component PMKSY 2.0
records.summary: Watershed treatment, conservation projects and geographic implementation reporting
records.eligibility_summary: Project-location-specific; not an automatic individual subsidy
records.farmer_action: State/district project dashboards and scheme explanation
records.review_notes: 2021-2026 period indicated by official page; follow-up status review needed

publication_rule: Do not import into approved scheme tables or eligibility engine without source-specific permission review, effective rule validation, and independent editor approval.
